title: Sharing Platform
description: Allow users to share models with controlled visibility (public, private, unlisted), shareable URLs and clean read-only public views.
rationale: Sharing turns private exploration into public conversation, drives organic reach via share URLs, and provides the population of public models that leaderboards rank.
success_criteria: An owner can set a model to public, private or unlisted
Public and unlisted models render read-only to non-owners
Private models are inaccessible to anyone but the owner
Share URLs resolve correctly per visibility rules
notes:
## Scope (in)
- Visibility states: public, private, unlisted
- Shareable URLs
- Read-only public views

## Out of scope
- Ranking/comparison (EPIC-007)
- Comments/social interaction (future)
- Collaborative editing (future)

## Dependencies
- EPIC-004 - models must exist and be persistable
- EPIC-005 - ownership/identity define who may change visibility

## Assumptions
- Visibility is an owner-controlled property of a model
- Unlisted = accessible via URL but not discoverable
- Public views must not leak owner-private data

## Risks
- Accidental exposure of private models -> default private; explicit publish; tests
- Share URLs guessable -> unguessable identifiers for unlisted models
- Public view leaks editable controls -> strict read-only path
- Stale shares after deletion -> defined 'removed' view

## Future extensions
- Comments / reactions on public models
- Embeddable model widgets
- Collaboration (shared editing) with permissions
